evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available after the wait; speech coded from burned-in captions (hook captions complete, later captions sampled once a second). Reel is posted by @livnat_ur with @matan.nistor as co-author (collab), not by Matan's own account. Whether the on-camera man is Matan is judged from his look and the co-author tag; not captioned. Audio is licensed music (Bad Bunny, MONACO) per dossier; speech under it cannot be confirmed. Comment sample not representative. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Couple's home tour of their rented penthouse in a Tel Aviv tower (22,500 shekels rent), room by room, with building pool and gym.
audience: general Instagram audience curious about wealth and luxury living, Matan and Livnat followers
caption_vs_video_note: Caption 'בואו לסיור בדירה שלנו..🥹🙈' matches: a home tour. The video opens as a street interaction (a passer-by 'asks' how much they pay) before the tour starts.

opening.first_frame: Man in a black leather jacket and a woman in a white shirt walk toward camera, holding hands, in a plaza of an office-residential complex; caption 'תגידו,' appears at 0.25 s.
opening.s0_1: Wide tracking shot, the couple walking toward the camera, caption 'תגידו,' (not a spoken-claim hook).
opening.s1_3: Continuous take as they approach; captions 'אפשר לשאול אותכם שאלה?' (1.75 s). They look at camera.
opening.s3_5: They stop in a medium shot looking into the lens; caption 'כמה אתם משלמים פה שכירות?' (3.5 s); green graphic '22,500₪' pops at 5 s.
opening.visual_hook: A staged street question to the couple, then a number graphic, then a visit to their home.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken (machine transcript) from 0 s, matching the captions: 'תגידו' 0 to 0.8 s, 'אפשר לשאול אתכם שאלה?' 1.4 s, rent question 3.4 s, answer '22.5' spoken at 5 s.
opening.text_hook: תגידו, / אפשר לשאול אותכם שאלה? / כמה אתם משלמים פה שכירות?
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 8 s ('סיור בדירה?' and the answer 'יאללה, בואי!' at 9 s)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: a question to the couple with the rent topic stated by 3.5 s; 'תגידו,' alone does not carry meaning
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: no (22.5 is spoken and shown at 5 s)
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions carry the whole dialogue

visual.subject_placement: Street shots: couple centred, caption mid-frame at about 55%. Tour: phone point of view walking through rooms; Livnat appears in 12 to 28 s, 31 to 38 s and 57 to 66 s as a guide, moving through frame.
visual.setting: Plaza outside a tower, then a high-floor penthouse with open kitchen, living room with bookshelf, home office, bedroom, wardrobe room, a second office/studio wall with event photos, three bathrooms, a balcony with a skyline view, then the building pool and gym.
visual.lighting: Daylight, bright interiors, natural window light.
visual.color_contrast: Neutral grey and white interiors, black and pink accents; white captions with black outline, bright green for emphasis words.
visual.props_and_gestures: Holding hands, a white handbag; Livnat gestures to rooms, sits in an armchair, lies on the bed; a door opened by hand at 49 s.
visual.supporting_footage: None separate: the whole video is one tour shot; the number graphic '22,500₪' (green, 5 s) is the only overlay. In the office the walls show large photos of Matan on stage (40 to 45 s).
visual.faces_blurred: no (passers-by in the background are distant)
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 10 s street scene with the rent question; 11 s door opens; 12 to 29 s living room, kitchen, library, offices; 28 to 38 s bedroom and wardrobe; 40 to 45 s the husband's office with stage photos; 46 to 56 s bathrooms; 57 to 62 s balcony; 62 to 66 s pool; 65 to 70 s gym; ends with 'תכתבו לנו מה דעתכם' text.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: cover is the street question frame 'כמה אתם משלמים פה שכירות?'
visual.ui_interference: Captions sit at about 55% height, clear of the zones; no text in the top or bottom zones seen.

editing.edit_function: Mostly stimulation and structure: each cut moves to a new room, matching the caption that names it; the green rent number graphic gives the key fact.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 10s: one continuous take (no cuts detected, though the shot reframes)
t=10.5 to 20s: a cut about every 1 s as the tour starts
t=20 to 60s: a cut every 1 to 5 s, slower in the bedroom (32.9 to 38.1 s)
t=61 to 67s: cuts of about 2 s
editing.ending: Gym shots with captions 'תכתבו לנו מה דעתכם ואם הייתם' then 'גרים כאן:' (about 69 to 70 s).
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: rooms are listed quickly; a viewer might replay to read captions or look at details. No loop.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript shows clear speech from 0 s: short street exchange to 9 s, then steady tour narration by Livnat in one sentence per room (1.5 to 3 s each) with no long pauses to 68 s.
sound.music: unclear (dossier lists licensed music, but the transcript prints no lyrics and the speech is clear; a music bed cannot be confirmed)
sound.sync: Captions change every 1 to 2 s and match the transcript line by line; each room caption lands as the narrator names the room.

text.colour_coding: White with black outline by default; green for emphasis words ('יאללה, בואי!' at 9 s, 'השירותי' at 50 s) and the money graphic '22,500₪'.
text.placement: Centre of frame, about 50 to 60% height.
text.style: Bold white condensed Hebrew font with black outline; no background box; some lines fade in as grey.
text.density_and_read_time: 2 to 5 words per caption, changing about every 1 to 2 s; easy.
text.language: Short chatty sentences, rhetorical humour: 'מכאן נעבור למשרד שלי', 'ממש ממש מהיר שתוכלו לראות..', 'כאן גרים'. Light, self-aware tone.
text.caption_structure: One line: 'בואו לסיור בדירה שלנו..🥹🙈', no hashtags, no CTA in the post caption.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew renders correctly; '₪' sits left of the digits in '22,500₪'.

story.setup: Street question to the couple: how much rent do you pay here?
story.stakes: Curiosity about a high rent figure.
story.progression: Number revealed (22,500₪), they invite the interviewer in, then a room by room tour with comments about the apartment's content.
story.payoff: A full tour of the penthouse, bathrooms, balcony, pool and gym.
story.resolution: Invite to comment what viewers think.
friction_points: t=0 to 4s: first sentence only 'תגידו,' (interpretation: low info)
t=24 to 38s: long stretch of empty rooms and bedroom (interpretation)
comments show a large part of the sample reading it as staged ('נראה מאד מקרי ורנדומלי')

explicit_prompts.spoken_too: said aloud at 67.9 s with 'ואם הייתם גרים כאן' (machine transcript)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 44 first-page comments, not representative. Nearly all are negative or mocking: rent, staging ('פייק וחרטא לא מאמינה'), taste ('מכוער'), and 'why rent not buy'. One tags Matan about his intentions. Several are jokes ('ולי יש מטוס פרטי').

conversion.cta_timing: about 68 s (opinion prompt, spoken and captioned)
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the opinion prompt fits a provocative home tour

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel, no pair in dossier)

rights_and_privacy: No third-party footage but licensed music; no minors; passers-by in the background are distant; interior shows the couple's home and building amenities, and Matan's stage photos on the wall.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a staged street question with a number (22,500 rent) creates curiosity and an invitation inside; the tour is easy to follow through captions and is the kind of luxury reveal people comment on strongly. The high comment ratio (782 comments, 1.0 per 1K views) comes from disagreement and ridicule.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: long empty-room stretches and little spoken payoff; the reaction is dominated by criticism rather than appreciation.

standout_moments.what: Green '22,500₪' graphic as the only overlay answers the opening question
'יאללה, בואי!' in green turns the street skit into an invitation
Office wall shows photos of Matan on stage, the only mention of his business inside the tour
Explicit prompt to comment an opinion that the audience clearly answered
